mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate drops below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that lowers borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when INDPRO and HOUST both decline but SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts indicates improving consumer confidence and economic expansion, which drives corporate investment and earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate drops below 7.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market expansion
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails when FEDFUNDS falls and PAYEMS rises but SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, which typically occur in the early stages of a recession, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.
